purpose: Pre-registered negative controls for the synthetic ledger contract. Catalog entries are planned probes, not evidence that a candidate mutant has already been built, compiled, or killed by the verifier.

accounting_rules.kill: A mutant is killed only when the locked oracle rejects its semantically incorrect behavior.
accounting_rules.excluded: Compile failures do not count as semantic kills. Equivalent mutants are excluded from the kill-rate denominator only after review; uncertain/equivalent/unrun cases remain separately reported.
accounting_rules.primary_score: Mutation results are verifier-quality metrics and do not enter task pass@1 directly.

mutations.transformation: Apply every exact duplicate row as a fresh financial transaction instead of idempotently ignoring it.
mutations.oracle_observation: Credits/debits and unique transaction counts diverge from the locked expected output.

mutations.transformation: Treat duplicate transaction IDs as equivalent whenever the amount matches, even if account or side differs.
mutations.oracle_observation: Conflicting account/side reuse must be rejected.

mutations.transformation: Parse amounts through floating point and truncate, thereby accepting a token such as 1.9 as 1.
mutations.oracle_observation: Non-digit amount tokens must be rejected rather than rounded or truncated.

mutations.transformation: Replace checked additions with wrapping or unchecked additions.
mutations.oracle_observation: A sum above u64::MAX must return an error, never a wrapped total.

mutations.transformation: Stream account/total output as rows are processed, before the entire input has validated.
mutations.oracle_observation: A late invalid row or conflicting duplicate must fail with empty stdout.

mutations.transformation: Skip the last field or silently accept a row with fewer/more than four fields.
mutations.oracle_observation: Malformed row shapes must be rejected before any report is emitted.

mutations.transformation: Swap CREDIT and DEBIT aggregation paths.
mutations.oracle_observation: Account and global credit/debit totals must match the golden contract.

mutations.transformation: Emit account totals in first-seen or HashMap iteration order instead of deterministic lexical order.
mutations.oracle_observation: Reordering input rows must not change canonical output or account ordering.

mutations.transformation: Accept zero-valued transactions as valid and count them in the report.
mutations.oracle_observation: Zero and negative amounts must fail closed.

mutations.transformation: Accept signs, whitespace, decimal points, exponent notation, or non-ASCII digits in amount tokens.
mutations.oracle_observation: Only ASCII digit tokens representing positive unsigned integers are accepted.

mutations.transformation: Accept unterminated quotes or characters immediately following a closed quoted field.
mutations.oracle_observation: Malformed quoting must produce an error without a report.

mutations.transformation: Treat a bare carriage return as a valid row ending or split CRLF into an extra record.
mutations.oracle_observation: CRLF is supported; bare CR is rejected; result remains stable with/without a final line ending.

mutations.transformation: Remove or weaken one required account/global-total assertion while retaining the happy-path compile.
mutations.oracle_observation: Task admission requires a locked oracle independent of candidate changes.

mutations.transformation: Change a raw-log hash or candidate patch hash without changing the referenced artifact.
mutations.oracle_observation: Independent auditor recomputes artifact hashes and rejects the mismatch.

mutations.transformation: Report a pass with a missing/changed checkout HEAD, unknown platform, or network-enabled runtime when offline mode is required.
mutations.oracle_observation: Environment mismatch makes the attempt unresolved/ineligible, not a pass.

mutations.transformation: Drop a required test result or mark a skipped test as passed without corresponding execution evidence.
mutations.oracle_observation: Required test inventory and each raw command/test receipt must reconcile; incomplete evidence suppresses the score.

mutations.transformation: Emit an extra empty record or reject an otherwise valid input solely because its final record separator is absent.
mutations.oracle_observation: Adding/removing one final LF must not change totals or the canonical report.

active_campaign.rule: A semantic kill requires the preregistered target unit test to fail after the mutant compiles; compile failures and unrelated test failures are unresolved.
